description: The storage->materializer rename left dead paths: storage.md's Location is lib/bedrock/data_plane/storage.ex (does not exist; actual: materializer.ex); basalt paths were removed in qzr.6 but other guides still cite lib/bedrock/data_plane/storage/... and line-numbered refs that have drifted (deep-dives/transactions.md: 'Storage fetch: storage.ex:33', 'Local write storage: lib/bedrock/cluster/gateway/transaction_builder/state.ex:16' — the transaction_builder now lives under lib/bedrock/internal/). Sweep every backtick code path and :line reference in guides/ against the tree; prefer module names over line numbers so refs do not rot.

comments.text: From the PR #175 cold audit (2026-08-20): guides/quick-reads/transaction-system-layout.md:44-55 now definitively lies - it shows id/director/rate_keeper (deleted by q67.9's final layer), storage_teams (long gone), and %TransactionSystemLayout{} struct syntax (it is a plain map); line 62 and guides/quick-reads/recovery/transaction-system-layout.md:38 cite transaction_system_layout_phase.ex which does not exist (now topology_phase.ex). The TSL is now wiring-only (epoch/sequencer/proxies/resolvers/logs/services - ClientDBInfo analogue); shard topology rides the keyspace and proxy-served routing.

Audit 2026-09-06: every stale path named here is gone (storage.ex, cluster/gateway/transaction_builder, transaction_system_layout_phase, storage_teams/rate_keeper in the TSL quick-read), and all lib/ and test/ paths cited in guides/ now exist. Remaining scope: the 9 :line references in deep-dives/transactions.md (server.ex:110, finalization.ex:257/421/522/602/744/829/856, log.ex:56) have drifted; finalization.ex:257 and :856 are blank lines. Replace with function names.

title: Dead code paths and stale line-number references across guides
